scenes.headline: THE TOWER MYSTERY
scenes.concept_takeaway: Bina chadhaye tower ki height naapo sirf ground distance aur angle se!
scenes.quick_tip: Jab Angle θ = 45° ho, tab Tower Height H hamesha Base D ke equal hogi!
scenes.narration: Ruko! Kya aap bina inch-tape leke upar chadhe, Qutub Minar ya kisi tall tower ki exact height sirf 5 seconds mein bata sakte ho? Bilkul! Jab aap neeche se tower ke top ko dekhte ho, toh banti hai Line of Sight aur Angle of Elevation. Chalo iska asli magic dekhte hain!

scenes.headline: GOLDEN RATIO TRIANGLES
scenes.concept_takeaway: 30°, 45°, 60° ke standard ratios yaad rakho, calculation half ho jayegi!
scenes.quick_tip: Door jaoge toh angle chhota (30°), paas aaoge toh angle bada (60°) hoga!
scenes.narration: Dekho kitna simple hai! Poore NCERT chapter mein 90 percent questions sirf teen golden angles par based hain: 30, 45, aur 60 degree! 45 degree par Perpendicular aur Base dono 1 ratio 1 hote hain. 60 degree par Height root 3 times Base hoti hai, aur 30 degree par Base root 3 times Height!

scenes.headline: 5-SEC BOSS CHALLENGE
scenes.concept_takeaway: 30° se 60° walk karne par cover kiya distance hamesha 2 units hota hai!
scenes.quick_tip: Topper Hack: 30° se 60° walk distance = 2 parts, aur bacha base = 1 part!
scenes.narration: Ab start karo 5-second timer! Board exam ka sabse favourite 5-mark question: Ek ship lighthouse ki taraf 40 meters chalti hai aur angle 30 degree se 60 degree ho jata hai. Bina long equation likhe Bas yeh 5-second Topper Shortcut lagao: 30 se 60 ka distance 2 parts hai, toh remaining base seedha half yaani 20 meters, aur Height 20 root 3 meters! Boom!

scenes.headline: #1 EXAM TRAP FIX
scenes.concept_takeaway: Angle of Depression hamesha TOP horizontal line se measure hota hai!
scenes.quick_tip: Warning: Depression angle kabhi vertical tower wall ke saath mat banana!
scenes.narration: Ruko! Board exam mein 80 percent students Angle of Depression ko galti se vertical tower wall ke saath bana dete hain aur zero milta hai! Yaad rakho, Depression angle hamesha top par ek imaginary horizontal line ke neeche banta hai, jo Z-rule se neeche ke Elevation angle ke barabar hota hai!
